from pathlib import Path
roots=[Path('backend/app'),Path('frontend/src'),Path('scripts')]
exts={'.py','.ts','.tsx','.js','.jsx','.css','.sh'}
rows=[]
for root in roots:
    for p in root.rglob('*'):
        if p.is_file() and p.suffix in exts:
            try: n=sum(1 for _ in p.open('r',encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore'))
            except OSError: continue
            rows.append((n,str(p)))
print('files',len(rows),'loc',sum(n for n,_ in rows))
print('top_30_by_loc')
for n,p in sorted(rows,reverse=True)[:30]: print(f'{n:5d} {p}')
for label,root in [('backend_tests',Path('backend/app/tests')),('frontend_unit',Path('frontend/src')),('frontend_e2e',Path('frontend/e2e'))]:
    pats=['test_*.py','*.test.ts','*.test.tsx','*.spec.ts']
    files=set()
    for pat in pats: files.update(root.rglob(pat))
    print(label,len(files))
PY
